text:
You need someone who can pre-qualify warm homeowners quickly, handle objections well, and keep lead flow organized for your closers while working on performance.  

I’m Mina Castellan, and with 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, SQL, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization, I bring a structured, coachable approach to fast-moving lead work.  

In my Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that consolidated 14 separate Excel reports and cut monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. In my Inventory reconciliation automation project for Coastline Hardware, I built a Power Query workbook that matched warehouse counts to the ERP each week and found $86k of stock variance while reducing weekly reconciliation from 6 hours to 20 minutes.  

I’d love to bring that same discipline, consistency, and performance mindset to your team.
